meta.name: executing-plans
meta.description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按写好的实施计划一步步把方案落地成可运行的代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里已有一份写好的实施计划,准备自己动手把它实现
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written implementation plan into working code, step by step
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have a written plan and want to implement it yourself.

howto.what: Claude 在当前会话里亲自逐条执行实现计划:按 TDD 顺序跑每一步、核对每步的 Expected 输出、按计划提交,并把进度和裁决记进 ledger 文件;最后对整条分支做一次全新审查。
howto.when: 当你在交接时选择「内联执行」一份写好的计划,或所用环境没有子代理(subagent)工具时,Claude 接管执行;任务大多彼此独立时适用。

say.text: 就按这份计划在当前会话里执行,任务之间别停下来问我。
say.note: 它会一口气跑完计划里的所有任务。

say.text: 先做 pre-flight 扫描,列出任务之间的接口冲突。
say.note: 冲突按 spec 裁决并写进 ledger。

say.text: 最后做一次整分支审查,给结论分级。

howto.what_en: Claude executes the plan itself in this session, task by task, with no per-task subagent: it follows TDD steps, checks each Expected output, commits as the plan says, and logs progress and rulings in a ledger file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you chose inline execution for a plan at the handoff, or your harness has no subagent tool; best when tasks are mostly independent.

say_en.text: Run this plan here, in this session, and don't check in between tasks.
say_en.note: It works through every task without stopping to ask.

say_en.text: Do the pre-flight scan and list interface conflicts between tasks.
say_en.note: Conflicts get a ruling against the spec, logged in the ledger.

say_en.text: Finish with one whole-branch review and grade the findings.
say_en.note: Critical and Important items get one fix pass.
